<!-- Workspace-specific guidance for The Black Empowerment Group website. -->

## Project

Standalone Next.js 15 App Router website for The Black Empowerment Group. Keep changes within this project; do not modify or import the separate `sunny-side-reunion` copy.

## Pages

- `app/page.tsx`: Home
- `app/services/page.tsx`: Services portfolio
- `app/contact-us/page.tsx`: Contact form

## Design

- Use the brand palette: black `#000000`, gold `#7F6000`, and platinum `#D9D9D9`.
- Keep the site responsive and preserve the shared header and footer.
- The contact form currently has no message-delivery integration; do not imply that inquiries are sent until one is configured.
